summary: Link ordered vectors, their normal and spanned parallelogram.
objective: Let me drag two vectors and see their cross product, right-hand direction and parallelogram area.
example_prompts: Let me drag two vectors and see their cross product, right-hand direction and parallelogram area.

entities.name: Inputs
entities.guidance: Draw u and v with labels, consistent length scale and a common origin.

entities.name: Normal
entities.guidance: Use an arrow whose length follows the actual cross product; annotate zero result rather than normalizing it.

entities.name: Area patch
entities.guidance: Use vertices 0,u,u+v,v; subdued surface and visible boundary keep vector order legible.

state_contract.model: Ordered real vectors u,v and computed cross product in a right-handed orthonormal frame.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.

invariants: Result is orthogonal to both inputs within tolerance.
Swap reverses result; parallel inputs give zero.
Normal length represents area units; disclose any display scaling.
motion_guidance: Compute from current inputs; avoid independently animated normal rotation.
At degeneracy hide direction arrowhead and label direction undefined for zero result.
known_limits: No torque or mechanics claim included.
Rendering and numeric tolerances still need artifact checks.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: The cross product is perpendicular to both input vectors and its magnitude gives the area of their parallelogram.
claims.scope: Real 3D vectors; zero product has no direction.

source_refs.locator: 2.4, cross product definition and Using the Cross Product
